_comment: FX-WEB-04: webhook_activity fan-out matrix + model_activity diff goldens. Transcribed from bgtasks/webhook_task.py:377-506.
error_rule: broad except: ObjectDoesNotExist -> SILENT return (race-condition path); any other exception -> print(e) only when settings.DEBUG, then log_exception + return. Return value always None.

fan_out.events_wiring: independent if-statements (module OR module_issue; cycle OR cycle_issue). An event key with NO matching branch (e.g. 'user', 'intake_issue') leaves the queryset UNFILTERED: every active webhook in the workspace fires. Port as-is.

per_webhook_delay.action: verb passthrough (NOT mapped; mapping happens inside the send task)
per_webhook_delay.event_data: ({'id': event_id} if verb == 'deleted' else get_model_data(event=event, event_id=event_id)) — deleted sends the bare id shape only
per_webhook_delay.task: webhook_send_task.delay(webhook_id=..., slug=..., event=..., event_data=..., action=..., current_site=..., activity=...)

created_branch.condition: current_instance is None (checked BEFORE any json parsing)

golden_diff.quirk_port_as_is: requested key 'priority' is ABSENT from current_instance, so no activity fires for it even though a value was requested. Requested key 'archived_at' likewise ignored.

model_activity.no_diff_no_dispatch: identical values for a present key -> no delay call
model_activity.rule: current_instance = json.loads(current_instance); for key in requested_data: if key in current_instance and current[key] != requested[key]: webhook_activity.delay(event=model_name, verb='updated', field=key, old_value=current, new_value=requested, old/new_identifier=None). Loop covers ADDED and REMOVED keys symmetrically via !=.
